entities.description: An elderly man with a white beard and mustache sits facing slightly to the left, wearing a brown plaid flat cap, a light blue button-down shirt with rolled sleeves, and a maroon and beige argyle sweater vest. He has a gentle smile and is wearing khaki trousers, with his hands resting on his thighs.

entities.description: A young man with short brown hair sits facing right, wearing a blue baseball cap, a red and navy plaid flannel shirt over a white t-shirt, and blue jeans. He has a black backpack strap over his right shoulder and is smiling while looking off-camera.
